image_description: A close-up, high-contrast black and white photograph of a Rawlings baseball. The image features selective color, highlighting a bright yellow smiley face button attached to the bottom of the ball. The baseball displays prominent red stitching (rendered in grayscale tones but structurally visible) and clear branding text including 'Rawlings' and 'OFFICIAL MAJOR LEAGUE BASEBALL'. A signature 'Vince W.' is visible in the bottom right corner.

The yellow smiley face button appears to float or merge with the ball's surface without a clear pin, shadow, or physical attachment mechanism, suggesting a compositing or generation error.
The signature 'Vince W.' is legible but has slight character deformation typical of AI-generated text, though it passes as a stylistic signature.
